I'm so surprised and sad, honestly, because I've been a customer of Nadia's for almost four years and have always received good service.
This time, I asked for a short haircut for my dog. And the person they sent doesn't know how to do their job.

1. They cut my dog's paw with a Navajo clipper.

2. The cut was terrible; they left a strip of hair on his paws, and even worse, they didn't shave his genitals. They shaved his whiskers!

3. They didn't bathe him because his ears still smelled.

4. And even so, they demanded I pay for the service, which I did, and all they said was that they would give me a discount. It's not really about the money, but the service, and who knows if they mistreated my dog?
I'm truly sorry for this review, but I'm outraged. And sad at the same time because I thought I'd be a customer forever. Oh well 😞
